evals.prompt: Rewrite to our Spring-aligned style: if (x == null) { return; } else { doThing(x); }
evals.expected_output: else on its own line; 4 spaces; K&R braces.
expectations: Uses else on its own line (not } else {)
Does not introduce unrelated logic changes

evals.prompt: Several assignment lines then if (size > capacity) evict — apply Helman blank-line rules and Spring this. field rules.
evals.expected_output: Blank line before if; fields referenced with this. if shown.
expectations: Blank line before if after dense code
Does not use Google } else { form

evals.prompt: In production Java for our style, may I use var? Should I write this.doWork() or doWork()? Tabs or spaces?
evals.expected_output: No var in production; no this. on methods; 4 spaces (Helman tweak vs Spring tabs).
expectations: Says not to prefix instance methods with this.

evals.prompt: Order these imports for a Spring-style file: org.springframework.util.Assert, java.util.List, static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat, jakarta.annotation.Nullable
evals.expected_output: java, then jakarta, then other, then org.springframework, then static — with blank lines per Spring import groups.
expectations: Places org.springframework after other third-party imports
Mentions blank lines between import groups or Spring import order
